messages:
Maya L: Quick playthrough of the new metric card — I'm seeing issues with mixed units on the y-axis when we auto-normalize. Screenshot attached (not included).

Alex P: Agree, noisy. Two quick options:
1) Show unit hint beside axis label: "Requests/sec (k)" when scaled.
2) Clamp extreme outliers for viewport rendering, reveal full value in tooltip on hover.

Jorge R: Clamping can hide incidents. Prefer 'squash' pattern: render overflow as a dotted area + explicit "overflow" tooltip showing true max.
ARIA note: y-axis should have aria-label="Requests per second (truncated scale)" and each overflow tooltip should be keyboard focusable.

Patrick H: Also add a user toggle for smoothing. For infra metrics default to raw, KPI cards can default to smoothed.

Maya L: Copy proposal: "Enable trend smoothing — reduces visual noise; spikes preserved on hover". Thoughts on placement? underneath chart header as a small tertiary control.

Olivia S: Legend order: follow stack order (top→bottom) not alpha. Keyboard nav should focus legend items in same order and allow Enter to toggle.

DesignBot: Preview deployed to staging: /deployments/metric-card/compact-signposting/preview

Alex P: I'll update the axis unit snippet and add the overflow pattern.

Maya L: assign @Alex P to the PR, @Jorge R to accessibility review. :eyes:

Jorge R: SGTM. Will check contrast ratios and keyboard flow.

Patrick H: tiny CSS for unit hint:
```
.y-axis .unit-hint { opacity: .65; font-size: 12px; margin-left: 6px; }
```

Olivia S: small nit: ensure unit hint is localized and uses aria-hidden="true" if repeated in label to avoid duplicate screen reader output.

Maya L: Thanks all — plan to ship stage 2 next Wed.
